card.name: Comparison words after and/or/to
card.fires_on: Words like 'more', 'less', '≤' and 'Certainly' right after 'and', 'or', 'to' or 'no'. They sit in range limits, thresholds and 'and more' endings.

modes.label: Range and limit words
modes.description: 'more', 'less' or '≤' after a connector in dose or lab-value thresholds.

modes.label: And more
modes.description: 'more' after 'and' ending a list or phrase such as 'and more recently'.

modes.label: Sentence-opening adverb
modes.description: An adverb such as 'Certainly' starting a sentence after a period.
modes.example: isosorbide mononitrate.<< Certainly>> nitrate ions liberated during metabolism of is
